description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If there is no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 创建下载任务时返回的长任务ID，请参见[CreateDownloadDataJob](~~445782~~)中的**LongJobId**参数。
description.en: The long job ID returned when you create a download job. For more information, see the **LongJobId** parameter in [CreateDownloadDataJob](~~445782~~).

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明

- 单个下载任务的下载链接一天内只能获取3次。
- 下载链接的有效期为5分钟。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

- The download link for a single download job can be retrieved up to three times per day.
- The download link has a validity period of 5 minutes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-download-file --context xxx_xxx --iot-instance-id iot-cn-npk1u000000 --long-job-id 62d949808bc742187xxxxxx --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
